title: Recipe servings + units across Menu · Recipe · Stock
summary: Recipes now have serving size (e.g. 1 plate / 4 servings). Stock deduction = (ingredient qty ÷ recipe servings) × sold qty. Units (kg, ml, pcs) stay on stock and recipe lines; plate cost is per serving.
highlights: Recipe: Sold as (plate/bowl/glass…) + Recipe written for N servings
Each stock line keeps unit (kg/ml/pcs) on the recipe
POS sale deducts by servings (family pack recipes supported)
g↔kg and ml↔L auto-convert when units differ
Menu Editor: serve unit + servings; plate cost per order
Export recipes includes servings and units
